notes: Star EMEA's PC point-of-sale cash drawer, driven from the peripheral drive circuit of a Star or Epson POS printer; the product page lists a UN version (8 upright note slots) and an FN version (4 flat note clips), both with 8 coin slots, while the datasheet gives 8 note and 8 coin slots plus an external voucher or cheque slot. It measures 410 x 415 x 114 mm and weighs 7 kg.

gaps: Neither Star page nor the datasheet says 'solenoid' or gives a coil rating, so the drawer release is described by the stated drive input (24 V, 1 A, 30-100 ms pulse); the solenoid_actuator type is the record's mapping.

Slot counts differ between sources: the datasheet gives 8 note and 8 coin slots plus an external voucher or cheque slot; the product page gives UN 8 upright note slots and FN 4 flat note clips, both with 8 coin slots.
Colours differ between the two Star sources and are not claimed.
The material is not stated on Star's pages, so none is claimed.
Both sources are Star EMEA; US versions were not checked.
The 3-position key lock and the cash tray are not rated in any source and the template has no lock type, so neither is claimed as a part.
method: Star EMEA CB-2002 product page, read through WebFetch for the versions and slot counts, DC 24 V 1 A, compulsion switch, key lock, dimensions and weight.

Star CB-2002 and CB-92 II specifications sheet (Star EMEA, UK 8.08), copy on hospitality.jarltech.com, read with the research tool's pdf command for input voltage and current, pulse time, the 6-pin modular plug and cable; the copy carries Star EMEA's own name and web address.
APG Vasario spec sheets (apgsolutions.com) returned HTTP 403 to the researcher and were not used.

comps.spec: Drawer release, driven by a pulse from the peripheral drive circuit of a Star or Epson POS printer; the datasheet gives the drawer's input as DC 24 V, 1 A with a pulse time of 30-100 ms
Compulsion switch, listed on the CB-2002 product page
Drawer cable: 6-pin modular plug on a shielded cable with a separate ground wire, linking the drawer to the printer's peripheral drive circuit
